tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Desktop ground behind panels and windows.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels: bar, launcher, popovers' base, window body.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised: menus, cards, list rows on hover, input fields.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected fills, track of switches and sliders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and pictograms on bg and every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata; still AAA on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (WCAG exempts disabled controls); 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: separators, list dividers. Never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (edits, checkboxes, outline buttons): 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, selected indicators, active workspace.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and pictograms on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text or link on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 1px solid, always offset 2px so it lands on the surface, never on the control fill. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fill and error marks.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill and marks.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill and marks; always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational fill and marks.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text on info.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal surfaces (lock screen, switcher) at 60% opacity.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "AtkynsonMono Nerd Font", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Lock-screen clock, calendar month numeral. One per surface.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings inside settings, launcher group names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Signal is ready to link with your phone.
styles.usage: Default text. 15px = the 11pt system font at 96 dpi.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bar items, status words, field labels. Uppercase only for section labels.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Terminal, paths, keyboard shortcuts. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, Nerd-patched.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls; window gaps (sway inner gap).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding, list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and popover padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Lock-screen and switcher outer padding.

border.note: Elevation is a surface step plus a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Separators and panel edges, in line.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Control borders, in line-strong.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, in focus, offset 2px.

tokens.name: border-indicator
tokens.usage: The one highlight: a 2px underline in accent under whatever is selected, focused-workspace, current or checked.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any clickable control and list row.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: size-icon-s
tokens.usage: Pictograms inside controls and pills.

tokens.name: size-icon-m
tokens.usage: Pictograms in list rows and settings sidebar.

tokens.name: size-icon-l
tokens.usage: App icons in the launcher grid.

tokens.name: size-icon-xl
tokens.usage: App icons in the Super+Tab switcher.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: scrim behind lock screen and switcher.
